IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=3.
NUMBER right=3.
LOOP (left>=0) { IF (values[left]*values[left]>4) { right=left. } left-=1. }
DISPLAYNL(right).
NUMBER left=3.
NUMBER right=0.
LOOP (left>=0) { IF (values[left]>left) { right=left. } left-=1. }
DISPLAYNL(right).

task_metadata.prompt: Read four pipe-separated numbers. Find the last position that is entry whose square exceeds four. In a separate traversal count positions through it that are entry greater than its zero-based position; if no anchor exists count zero. Add 1.
